We help businesses hire the right talent and improve workforce performance. Role Description We are hiring an IT Manager – Operations to ensure the complete availability, performance, and cybersecurity of our IT operation, biometric infrastructure, and network systems. Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, this role maintains critical system uptime and strict data compliance across all operational touchpoints. Requirement Oversee end-to-end technical support, hardware/software deployment, biometric platforms, and network infrastructure across operational centres. Ensure continuous uptime and performance for visa processing systems, appointment engines, and payment gateways. Implement cybersecurity controls, access management, data protection standards, and disaster recovery protocols. Manage IT asset inventory, system backups, updates, patches, and antivirus compliance. Coordinate with regional/global IT units, vendor partners, diplomatic missions, and internal operations leads. Drive audit readiness, new centre rollouts, system migrations, and vendor contract budgets. Qualification Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or Engineering. Experience: 8–10 years in IT, with 3–5 years in a leadership role. Experience in high-security, transaction-based sectors (Banking, Government, BPO, or Payments) is required. Technical Expertise: Infrastructure/architecture, network security (LAN/WAN, VPN, firewalls), system integration, and data governance. Flexibility: Willingness to support peak-time operations and travel locally/internationally.

review_candidates.title: Senior Systems Engineer, Computer Hardware
review_candidates.description: Tracking Code 9767-987 Posted Date 9/6/2026 Job Location Patuxent River, Maryland Location of Position Patuxent River, Maryland Work Arrangement On Site: 100% Position Type Full-Time/Regular Clearance Required? Yes Level of Clearance Required TS-SCI COLSA is seeking a Senior Systems Engineer, Computer Hardware to provide programmatic and technical leadership in the engineering development of modern complex systems supporting cyber warfare programs. This position will also serve as a functional team lead, providing technical leadership and coordinating the work of team members. This position is located on-site at Naval Air Station Patuxent River, Maryland. This position is contingent upon contract award. The selected candidate will be proposed as Key Personnel in accordance with proposal requirements. Duties & Responsibilities Provide programmatic and technical leadership in identifying, formulating, designing, and testing practical solutions to engineering problems. Guide the engineering development of modern complex systems using systems engineering methods and tools. Research, design, develop, and test computer or computer-related equipment for military applications, including airborne platforms. Conduct research in applied systems engineering to advance the field, as appropriate. May supervise the manufacturing and installation of computer or computer-related equipment and components. Coordinate and oversee the tasking of team members performing systems engineering functions. Track project progress and participate in the planning of projects, resourcing, and events. Integrate systems engineering outputs with cyber defense, vulnerability research, and authorization workflows. At COLSA, people are our most valuable resource and centered at our core value. We invite you to unite your talents with opportunity and be a part of our “Family of Professionals!” Learn about our employee-centric culture and benefits here: https://www.colsa.com/culture_benefits Required Experience Required Qualifications: Must meet one of the following education and experience combinations: MS/MA degree from an accredited college or university in Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related scientific discipline, with at least 10 years of experience performing work related to computer hardware systems engineering, including at least 3 years within the past 5 years; OR BS/BA degree from an accredited college or university in Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related scientific discipline, with at least 14 years of relevant experience, including at least 4 years of recent and relevant experience. At least 3 years of experience directly related to airborne systems. Demonstrated knowledge and expertise in the applicable engineering discipline. Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, coordinate team tasking, track project progress, and support project and resource planning. Must possess a current Top Secret security clearance with eligibility for SCI. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting NAVAIR, NAWCAD, or other Navy aviation programs. Experience with Navy airborne platforms and weapon systems. Applicant selected may be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. COLSA Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer, Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin. Minimum Salary $150,000.00 Maximum Salary $185,000.00 Salary Type Annually The salary range, if referenced, represents a good faith estimate. COLSA considers various factors when determining base salary offers, but not limited to, location, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. COLSA offers a comprehensive and customizeable benefits program which includes Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, Accidental Death & Dismemberment, Supplemental Income Protection Programs, 401(k) with company match, Flexible Spending Accounts, Employee Assistance Program, Education & Certification Reimbursement, Employee Discount Program, Paid Time Off and Holidays. This position will be posted for a minimum of 3 business days. If a candidate has not been selected at that time, it will continue to be posted until a suitable candidate is selected or the position is closed.

Du profitierst von flachen Hierarchien und einer offenen, ehrlichen Unternehmenskultur. Dich erwartet eine attraktive Vergütung sowie eine strukturierte Einarbeitung mit einem persönlichen Mentor. review_candidates.title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
review_candidates.description: ThetaRay is a trailblazer in AI-powered Anti-Money Laundering (AML) solutions, offering cutting-edge technology to fintech's, banks, and regulatory bodies worldwide. Our mission is to enhance trust in financial transactions, ensuring compliant and innovative business growth. Our technology empowers customers to expand into new markets and introduce groundbreaking products. ThetaRay is a culture-driven company. Our values are at the heart of our success. By joining us, you'll have the opportunity to embody these values and inspire others through your actions. Why Join ThetaRay? At ThetaRay, you will be part of a dynamic global team committed to redefining the financial services sector through technological innovation. You will contribute to creating safer financial environments and have the opportunity to work with some of the brightest minds in AI, ML, and financial technology. We offer a collaborative, inclusive, and forward-thinking work environment where your ideas and contributions are valued and encouraged. Join us in our mission to revolutionize the financial world, making it safer and more trustworthy for millions worldwide. Explore exciting career opportunities at ThetaRay – where innovation meets purpose. We are looking for a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join our growing Global Support organization. The person is responsible for resolving technical issues and taking part in the deployment and delivery of our solutions. The ideal candidate will possess technical expertise, exceptional problem-solving skills, and the ability to work under pressure to provide outstanding service to our customers globally. Responsibilities: Technical escalations - Resolve issues that are escalated from Tier 1 support Customer communication - Engage directly with customers on multiple issues, providing clear and concise communication throughout the life cycle of the case Become a product expert for customers and stay up-to-date on new features Support our customers during the onboarding, implementation, and production phases including incidents and deployments Work closely with the Tier 3 Engineers and escalate according to our escalation flows Knowledge management - Document solutions and best practices to assist other support teams and reduce future escalations Participate in our global On Call rotation KPIs - Adhere to strict KPI’s and SLAs both internally and externally Requirements: Minimum of 2+ years of experience in a Technical Support organization - must Experience in SysAdmin on Linux environment and networking - must Experience with AI-driven support ecosystems, including agent/skill development and understanding of AI workflows for automated triage, log analysis, and incident resolution. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a proven ability to solve technical problems Experience with Kubernetes administration (Azure, AWS, AKS, RedHat, OCP) - must Experience working with SQL databases - an advantage Hands-on experience with version-control tools such as GIT/BitBucket - an advantage Business-oriented and able to work with external customers and cross-functional teams Team player Fluent French language skills - Advantage Please share your CV in English, fluent English language skills are a requirement for this role.

review_candidates.title: Systemadministrator - IT (m/w/d)
review_candidates.description: Über diesen Job Apoprojekt ist Partner für jeden Transformationsbedarf im Bestand und eines der dynamischsten Unternehmen der Bau- und Immobilienbranche. Seit unserer Gründung 2007 sind wir von einem Zwei-Mann-Unternehmen zu einer Größe von mehr als 600 Mitarbeitenden gewachsen. Wir wollen den Markt verändern: mit unserem Design-& Build-Ansatz und weniger Schnittstellen zwischen Planung und Ausführung. Mit mehr Miteinander und voller Verantwortung für unsere Projekte. Um die besten Teams der Branche zusammenzustellen, suchen wir die kompetentesten und talentiertesten Mitarbeitenden. Und dafür brauchen wir genau Dich! Was uns besonders auszeichnet, ist unsere gelebte Werte- und Unternehmenskultur. Bei uns erwarten Dich nicht nur Aufgaben mit einer steilen Lernkurve - sondern auch ein spürbarer Teamspirit. Bist Du dabei? Du möchtest nicht nur Systeme betreiben, sondern die Zukunft der Zusammenarbeit mitgestalten? Im Innovation Hub von apoprojekt sorgst Du dafür, dass unsere Microsoft-, Cloud- und KI-Plattformen sicher, stabil und effizient funktionieren. Du bringst neue Technologien wie Microsoft Copilot und KI-Agenten erfolgreich in den Arbeitsalltag Deiner Kolleginnen und Kollegen und verbindest dabei modernes Cloud-Management mit echter Innovationsarbeit! DEINE HERAUSFORDERUNG Als Teil unseres Innovation Hubs bringst Du neue KI-Lösungen erfolgreich in den Regelbetrieb und bringst aktiv eigene Ideen ein, wie KI, Automatisierungen und moderne Microsoft-Technologien unsere Arbeitsweise verbessern können. Du beschäftigst Dich aktiv mit neuen KI-Technologien wie Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio und KI-Agenten, bewertest deren Potenzial und unterstützt deren technische Implementierung. Du administrierst und betreibst unsere Microsoft-365-, Azure- und KI-Plattformen und übernimmst das Management von Benutzerkonten, Rollen, Berechtigungen und Lizenzen Du stellst den stabilen, sicheren und skalierbaren Betrieb unserer KI- und Cloud-Lösungen sicher und verantwortest Monitoring, Wartung, Updates sowie die technische Dokumentation. DEIN PROFIL, UM GEMEINSAM ETWAS ZU BEWEGEN Du verfügst über eine IT-Ausbildung, ein IT-Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation und hast bereits praktische Erfahrung in der Administration von Microsoft-Umgebungen gesammelt. Du kennst Dich mit Microsoft 365, Azure und Microsoft Entra ID aus und hast Erfahrung im Umgang mit Benutzerkonten, Berechtigungen, Rollen und Lizenzen Du begeisterst Dich für KI-Anwendungen wie Microsoft Copilot und verfolgst neue technologische Entwicklungen mit Neugier und Offenheit. Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und serviceorientiert und kannst technische Themen verständlich mit Kolleg:innen, Fachbereichen und externen Partnern abstimmen. BENEFITS Flexible Arbeitszeiten & Homeoffice: individuelle Lösungen, die sowohl den Arbeitsabläufen als auch den persönlichen Bedürfnissen gerecht werden. Mobilität: Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket, Company Bike, Dienstwagen und Carsharing. Sportangebote: vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Urban Sports Club oder EGYM Wellpass sowie Teamfit-Challenge. Onboarding & Weiterbildungsangebote: umfassendes Onboarding inklusive Onboarding-Event in Hamburg und vielseitige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten. Excellent organisational skills, with a track record of managing several workstreams at once and meeting deadlines without supervision. Fast, action oriented and comfortable with ambiguity in a small team where everyone does a bit of everything. Sound judgement and discretion when handling sensitive institutional relationships. Confident with digital tools, including Google Workspace, LinkedIn and standard design and scheduling platforms. Able to work in the Central European Time zone. Desirable Experience in a ministry of foreign affairs, embassy, international organisation, think tank or similar institutional environment. Familiarity with protocol conventions and diplomatic correspondence. Interest in or exposure to technology policy, digital governance or tech diplomacy. Portuguese, Spanish, French or Arabic, given our activity in Latin America, Europe, Africa and Asia. Experience coordinating international events or expert networks. What we offer Direct exposure to senior diplomatic, governmental and industry counterparts. A wide brief with real responsibility from the outset, in a young institute that is still taking shape. The chance to contribute to the substance of TDGI’s research and publications, not only its operations. A distributed, international team. Qualitätssicherung im Team: Regelmäßige Deep-Dive-Reviews in den Konten der Teammitglieder zur Potenzialerkennung und Leistungssteigerung. Kampagnensteuerung: Setup, Steuerung und Optimierung von Kampagnen (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Web Analytics) über alle relevanten Kanäle (Search, Shopping, PMAX, YouTube etc.). Performance & Consulting: Analyse wirtschaftlicher KPIs, Ableitung proaktiver Handlungsempfehlungen und eigenständige Führung von Kunden-Terminen zur Identifikation neuer Wachstumschancen. 3. Prozessoptimierung & Qualitätssicherung Standardisierung: Definition und Überwachung von agenturweiten Qualitätsstandards für Kampagnen-Setups, Reportings und Audits. Skalierung: Aktive Automatisierung und Effizienzsteigerung von Arbeitsabläufen 4. Business Development & Repräsentation Sales-Unterstützung: Ausarbeitung von Potenzialanalysen und teilweise Mitwirken an Sales-Meetings. Außenauftritt: Begleitung des Geschäftsführers (Sergej) auf Fachmessen inklusive operativer Unterstützung. Qualifikation Erfahrung**:** Du bringst mindestens 5 Jahre praktische Erfahrung im Performance-Marketing (SEA) mit, idealerweise mit einem starken Hintergrund im Agenturumfeld. Hands-On Mentalität: wir sind ein kleines Team (aktuell 7 Personen) und es wird von dir verlangt, dass du sehr proaktiv arbeitest. Leadership-Skillset: Du hast bereits Teams geführt oder erfolgreich Mentoring-Aufgaben übernommen. Du weißt, wie man motiviert und Wissen transferiert. Technisches Tiefenwissen: Google Ads, Google Merchant Center und GA4 sind dein Zuhause. Du verstehst den Google Tag Managre und hast keine Scheu vor Skripten oder technischer Implementierung. Bonus wäre Erfahrung mit Feed Management und anderen SEA spezifischen Tools. Analytisches Mindset: Begriffe wie Attributionsmodelle, Consent Banner Anpassungen und Wettbewerbsanalysen sind für dich tägliches Handwerkszeug. Kundenorientierte, selbstständige, strukturierte und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise mit ausgeprägter Dienstleistungsorientierung. Die Analyse und Auswertung von Daten gehört zu Deinen größten Stärken. Du wertest Deine Kampagnen aus und triffst auf Basis Deiner Analyse die nächste Entscheidung. Dein selbstbewusstes Auftreten, Deine souveräne Art sowie starke Kommunikations Skills zeichnen Dich aus und machen Dich unheimlich erfolgreich im Kundenkontakt/ in der Kundenbetreuung, sowie im Kontakt mit deinem Team. Nice to have: Abgeschlossenes wirtschaftliches Studium und/ oder vergleichbarer Studiengang/ Ausbildung. Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Sprache und Schrift (Deutsch ist zwingend notwendig, da der Kundenkontakt auf Deutsch ist). Fester Wohnsitz in Deutschland Benefits Erlebe eine wachsende Agentur hautnah und nutze die Möglichkeit, direkt an Entscheidungen beteiligt zu sein und aktiv mitzugestalten, anstatt in eingestaubten Strukturen gefangen zu sein. Flache Hierarchien: direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Sergej, dem Geschäftsführer Steile Lernkurve durch Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten durch unsere jahrelange Erfahrung im SEA und Web Analytics und jährlicher Besuch von Fachmessen oder Schulungen. Lange Kundenbindung ermöglicht es, sich sehr tief mit unseren Kunden und ihren Prozessen auseinander zu setzen, um gemeinsam mit den Kunden zu wachsen. Maximal 5 Kunden pro Mitarbeiter. Zugriff auf unser sehr umfangreiches internes Wissens Wiki. Quartalsweise mehrtätige Meetings mit dem ganzen Team für gemeinsames Arbeiten, Workshops und Teambuilding Aktivitäten. Ausstattung mit Apple MacBook, großem Bildschirm und hochwertigen Peripheriegeräte. Home Office (innerhalb Deutschlands) mit Option ins Büro in Hamburg zu kommen. Zusätzlich die Möglichkeit vereinzelnt aus dem EU-Ausland zu arbeiten. Flexible Arbeitszeiten - 39h Wochenarbeitszeit mit Kernarbeitszeiten von Mo. - Fr. 10:00 - 15:00. 30 Tage Urlaub + 1 Urlaubstag am Geburtstag + Halber Tag am 24. & 31.12 = Bis zu 32 Urlaubstage. Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft. Wir wünschen uns auch, dass Du Deine Expertise einbringst und uns als Team weiter entwickelst. Der interne Austausch ist uns sehr wichtig, denn nur so ist ein gesundes menschliches und fachliches Wachstum möglich. Schick uns Deinen Lebenslauf oder Dein gepflegtes LinkedIn Profil zu und erzähle uns über Deine bisherigen praktischen Erfahrungen im SEA als auch in der Kundenbetreuung. Wir freuen uns sehr auf Deine Bewerbung! Im ersten Schritt möchten wir gerne einen 30-minütigen Termin mit Dir vereinbaren, um einen ersten Eindruck zu gewinnen. Anschließend folgt eine Case-Study, damit wir dich auf der Basis persönlich nach Hamburg einladen, um das abschließende Gespräch zu führen.

review_candidates.title: Specialist Plant Manager
review_candidates.description: At Sisk, we create places and infrastructure that shape how people live, work and connect - now and for future generations. As a family‑owned, international construction and engineering group, we offer meaningful careers across building, infrastructure, rail, energy and off‑site manufacturing throughout Ireland, the UK and Europe, where people are supported to grow, make an impact and be part of positive change. The Specialist Plant Manager acts as the Group Subject Matter Expert for the provision, deployment, and governance of Specialist Plant & Equipment across Sisk projects. The role ensures that all specialist plant solutions are safe and compliant with statutory and Sisk standards, technically robust and fit for purpose, commercially optimised through effective use of owned and hired assets, and efficiently deployed to support project delivery. A key focus of the role is the oversight of high-risk operations, ensuring market-leading solutions are delivered that enhance safety, productivity, and value for Sisk, its clients, and partners. Health, Safety & Compliance Regulatory Alignment Maintain compliance with UK lifting regulations (LOLER 1998, BS 7121) and Irish legislation (Safety, Health and Welfare at Work Regulations). Audit Management Lead regular, rigorous safety and operational compliance audits across all active regional sites. Incident Investigation Support technical investigations into plant near-misses or failures, delivering root-cause analysis reports. Risk & Technical Management Documentation Control Author, review, and approve complex Risk Assessments and Method Statements (RAMS). High-Risk Operations Offer subject matter expert support to critical, high-risk technical operations including tandem lifts, blind lifts, and complex technical rigging. Engineering Review support our Projects with best use of product placement, including liaisons with our Engineering Services Teams Asset Lifecycle & Logistics Crane Oversight Manage the deployment, erection, and dismantling of tower cranes, crawler cranes, and mobile units. Access & Hoists Supervise the installation and safety verification and all hoisting operations. Procurement & Supply Chain Management Vendor Selection Establish and manage a multi-jurisdictional framework agreement for tier-1 plant, crane, and hoist suppliers across the UK and Ireland. Contract Negotiation Negotiate high-value hire contracts, service level agreements (SLAs), and mobilisation/demobilisation costs to secure maximum commercial value. Supply Chain Audit Conduct safety, financial, and operational compliance audits on third-party plant providers and transport subcontractors. Financial & Budgetary Control Capex/Opex Management Support multi-million-pound/euro capital expenditure (CAPEX) for asset purchasing and operational expenditure (OPEX). Cost Optimisation Track, analyse, and report on plant utilisation rates and running costs to optimise the asset life’s cycle. Financial Accountability P&L accountability. Specialist Plant Expertise - Deep technical understanding of cranes, lifting operations, hoisting systems, mast climbers, and related high-risk plant. Strong knowledge of operational risks, constraints, and mitigation measures across complex construction environments. Industry Experience - Minimum 10 years’ experience in crane operations, specialist plant deployment, and major project mobilisations within Ireland and/or the UK, including at least 5 years operating at management or supervisory level with Tier 1 contractors or specialist providers. Regulatory & Compliance Knowledge - Comprehensive knowledge of relevant legislation and industry standards, including LOLER, BS 7121, and Irish construction safety regulations. Proven ability to interpret, implement, and audit compliance frameworks. Technical & Engineering Capability - Ability to review and interpret technical drawings, lift plans, structural calculations, and crane schematics. Experience in CAD/BIM-supported crane planning and temporary works coordination. Project & Operational Management - Strong project planning and coordination skills, including sequencing of complex lifts, logistics planning, and multi-stakeholder interface management across project teams and supply chain partners. Commercial Acumen - Demonstrated ability to manage hire costs, negotiate supplier agreements, and optimise plant utilisation. Strong understanding of CAPEX/OPEX considerations and cost drivers within specialist plant. Communication & Stakeholder Management - Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence project teams, clients, and supply chain partners. Capable of presenting technical solutions clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Digital & Systems Capability - Proficient in MS Office suite, with working knowledge of CAD/BIM tools and digital systems used for planning, reporting, and analysis. Required Appointed Person (Lifting Operations) or CPCS Crane Supervisor license Working at Heights (WAH) UK or IRL equivalents Desirable BIM/AUTOCAD Engineering qualifications - structural or mechanical Concrete Pumping experience would be an advantage. review_candidates.description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About The Role As an Infrastructure & Deployment DevOps Engineer , you will play a key role in designing the software systems that power our manufacturing and production environment . You will architect and maintain the deployment pipelines, infrastructure automation, and fleet management solutions for our internal production assets—including engineering workstations, automated test benches, and IIoT components . Your mission is to ensure that our production line is a high-performance, reproducible, and scalable environment that enables our R&D and manufacturing teams to move at lightning speed. Responsibilities Internal Fleet Management – Design and maintain systems to coordinate software updates and manage life-cycles across a diverse fleet of production workstations and industrial compute nodes. Infrastructure Automation – Develop and maintain automated deployment solutions for test benches and IIoT devices using containerization tools (Docker, Docker Compose, Portainer). Scalable CI/CD for Production – Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions/GitLab CI) that support the rapid delivery of automation tools and inspection software to the factory floor. Reproducible Environments – Utilize declarative build systems (e.g., Docker Bake, Ansible) to ensure that every test bench and workstation in the facility is configured identically and can be recovered instantly. Cross-Team Collaboration – Partner with R&D, Manufacturing, and Quality teams to deliver reliable, secure, and maintainable automation solutions for our internal operations. Candidate Requirements MSc in Software, Electrical, Computer Science, or a related engineering field. 3+ years of professional experience in a software engineering role with a heavy focus on infrastructure, DevOps, or industrial automation. Expert Python Skills – Proficiency in scripting, automation, and building deployment tooling. Containerization Mastery – Hands-on experience deploying software at scale using Docker and orchestration tools. Fleet & Config Management – Experience with tools like Ansible for workstation configuration or IoT platforms (e.g., AWS IoT Greengrass) for managing distributed industrial assets. Excellent communication skills and proven ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

Die Konfiguration und Administration von Cloud Anwendungen - insbesondere M365, zählt ebenfalls zu deinen Aufgaben. Stattdessen übernimmst du Verantwortung, bringst eigene Ideen ein und arbeitest in einem engagierten, kollegialen Team zusammen. Nachhaltigkeit und Werteorientierung haben für dich eine ebenso große Bedeutung wie eine ausgeprägte Leidenschaft für die IT. Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung im IT-Bereich (z.B. Du hast bereits erste Erfahrung in der IT-Systemadministration gesammelt oder bringst die Fähigkeit und Motivation mit, dich strukturiert in Hardware-, Netzwerk- und Kommunikationstechnik einzuarbeiten. Interesse und vorhandenes Wissen bzgl. C#/.NET/T-SQL sind von Vorteil und können auch aktiv eingebracht/entwickelt werden. Du verfügst über verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und gute Englisch-Kenntnisse sowie die Bereitschaft bei Bedarf an unsere Standorte zu reisen. Wir Bieten: Du wirst Teil eines zukunftsorientierten Unternehmens, das sich für nachhaltige Finanzlösungen einsetzt. Du arbeitest in einem modernen, dynamischen und kreativen Umfeld mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Du hast die Möglichkeit, teilweise mobil zu arbeiten. Du profitierst von flachen Hierarchien und einer offenen, ehrlichen Unternehmenskultur. Dich erwartet eine attraktive Vergütung sowie eine strukturierte Einarbeitung mit einem persönlichen Mentor. Du kannst dich in einem innovativen Unternehmen weiterentwickeln und Verantwortung übernehmen. Du arbeitest in einem großartigen Team mit einer anspruchsvollen und inspirierenden Arbeitsatmosphäre. Du profitierst von regelmäßigen internen und externen Weiterbildungsangeboten. Du wirst Teil einer Unternehmenskultur, die auf Teamgeist, gegenseitige Unterstützung und regelmäßige gemeinsame Events setzt. Du profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, sowie zusätzlichen Benefits wie betrieblicher Altersvorsorge und einem Jobticket. new_matches.title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
new_matches.description: ThetaRay is a trailblazer in AI-powered Anti-Money Laundering (AML) solutions, offering cutting-edge technology to fintech's, banks, and regulatory bodies worldwide. Our mission is to enhance trust in financial transactions, ensuring compliant and innovative business growth. Our technology empowers customers to expand into new markets and introduce groundbreaking products. ThetaRay is a culture-driven company. Our values are at the heart of our success. By joining us, you'll have the opportunity to embody these values and inspire others through your actions. Why Join ThetaRay? At ThetaRay, you will be part of a dynamic global team committed to redefining the financial services sector through technological innovation. You will contribute to creating safer financial environments and have the opportunity to work with some of the brightest minds in AI, ML, and financial technology. We offer a collaborative, inclusive, and forward-thinking work environment where your ideas and contributions are valued and encouraged. Join us in our mission to revolutionize the financial world, making it safer and more trustworthy for millions worldwide. Explore exciting career opportunities at ThetaRay – where innovation meets purpose. We are looking for a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join our growing Global Support organization. The person is responsible for resolving technical issues and taking part in the deployment and delivery of our solutions. The ideal candidate will possess technical expertise, exceptional problem-solving skills, and the ability to work under pressure to provide outstanding service to our customers globally. Responsibilities: Technical escalations - Resolve issues that are escalated from Tier 1 support Customer communication - Engage directly with customers on multiple issues, providing clear and concise communication throughout the life cycle of the case Become a product expert for customers and stay up-to-date on new features Support our customers during the onboarding, implementation, and production phases including incidents and deployments Work closely with the Tier 3 Engineers and escalate according to our escalation flows Knowledge management - Document solutions and best practices to assist other support teams and reduce future escalations Participate in our global On Call rotation KPIs - Adhere to strict KPI’s and SLAs both internally and externally Requirements: Minimum of 2+ years of experience in a Technical Support organization - must Experience in SysAdmin on Linux environment and networking - must Experience with AI-driven support ecosystems, including agent/skill development and understanding of AI workflows for automated triage, log analysis, and incident resolution. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a proven ability to solve technical problems Experience with Kubernetes administration (Azure, AWS, AKS, RedHat, OCP) - must Experience working with SQL databases - an advantage Hands-on experience with version-control tools such as GIT/BitBucket - an advantage Business-oriented and able to work with external customers and cross-functional teams Team player Fluent French language skills - Advantage Please share your CV in English, fluent English language skills are a requirement for this role.

new_matches.title: Systemadministrator - IT (m/w/d)
new_matches.description: Über diesen Job Apoprojekt ist Partner für jeden Transformationsbedarf im Bestand und eines der dynamischsten Unternehmen der Bau- und Immobilienbranche. Seit unserer Gründung 2007 sind wir von einem Zwei-Mann-Unternehmen zu einer Größe von mehr als 600 Mitarbeitenden gewachsen. Wir wollen den Markt verändern: mit unserem Design-& Build-Ansatz und weniger Schnittstellen zwischen Planung und Ausführung. Mit mehr Miteinander und voller Verantwortung für unsere Projekte. Um die besten Teams der Branche zusammenzustellen, suchen wir die kompetentesten und talentiertesten Mitarbeitenden. Und dafür brauchen wir genau Dich! Was uns besonders auszeichnet, ist unsere gelebte Werte- und Unternehmenskultur. Bei uns erwarten Dich nicht nur Aufgaben mit einer steilen Lernkurve - sondern auch ein spürbarer Teamspirit. Bist Du dabei? Du möchtest nicht nur Systeme betreiben, sondern die Zukunft der Zusammenarbeit mitgestalten? Im Innovation Hub von apoprojekt sorgst Du dafür, dass unsere Microsoft-, Cloud- und KI-Plattformen sicher, stabil und effizient funktionieren. Du bringst neue Technologien wie Microsoft Copilot und KI-Agenten erfolgreich in den Arbeitsalltag Deiner Kolleginnen und Kollegen und verbindest dabei modernes Cloud-Management mit echter Innovationsarbeit! DEINE HERAUSFORDERUNG Als Teil unseres Innovation Hubs bringst Du neue KI-Lösungen erfolgreich in den Regelbetrieb und bringst aktiv eigene Ideen ein, wie KI, Automatisierungen und moderne Microsoft-Technologien unsere Arbeitsweise verbessern können. Du beschäftigst Dich aktiv mit neuen KI-Technologien wie Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio und KI-Agenten, bewertest deren Potenzial und unterstützt deren technische Implementierung. Du administrierst und betreibst unsere Microsoft-365-, Azure- und KI-Plattformen und übernimmst das Management von Benutzerkonten, Rollen, Berechtigungen und Lizenzen Du stellst den stabilen, sicheren und skalierbaren Betrieb unserer KI- und Cloud-Lösungen sicher und verantwortest Monitoring, Wartung, Updates sowie die technische Dokumentation. DEIN PROFIL, UM GEMEINSAM ETWAS ZU BEWEGEN Du verfügst über eine IT-Ausbildung, ein IT-Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation und hast bereits praktische Erfahrung in der Administration von Microsoft-Umgebungen gesammelt. Du kennst Dich mit Microsoft 365, Azure und Microsoft Entra ID aus und hast Erfahrung im Umgang mit Benutzerkonten, Berechtigungen, Rollen und Lizenzen Du begeisterst Dich für KI-Anwendungen wie Microsoft Copilot und verfolgst neue technologische Entwicklungen mit Neugier und Offenheit. Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und serviceorientiert und kannst technische Themen verständlich mit Kolleg:innen, Fachbereichen und externen Partnern abstimmen. BENEFITS Flexible Arbeitszeiten & Homeoffice: individuelle Lösungen, die sowohl den Arbeitsabläufen als auch den persönlichen Bedürfnissen gerecht werden. Mobilität: Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket, Company Bike, Dienstwagen und Carsharing. Sportangebote: vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Urban Sports Club oder EGYM Wellpass sowie Teamfit-Challenge. Onboarding & Weiterbildungsangebote: umfassendes Onboarding inklusive Onboarding-Event in Hamburg und vielseitige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten. Building Teams: Firmen- und Teamevents sowie Skifreizeit. Unterstützung in allen Lebenslagen: pme Familienservice, der in herausfordernden Zeiten unterstützt.

new_matches.title: IT Projects Director
new_matches.description: Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond. About Us SBM Offshore is a global leader in deepwater ocean infrastructure, delivering floating production solutions across the full asset lifecycle—from design and construction to installation and operation. Supported by a global team of more than 8,000 professionals, the Company operates a long-term, asset-backed business model that delivers high-availability assets and predictable cash flows. SBM Offshore combines engineering expertise, operational reliability, and selective innovation to support safe, efficient, and lower-carbon energy production, while extending its capabilities into new opportunities across the blue economy. Purpose The IT Projects Director is an executive leader responsible for the overall delivery of ICT and Digital build activities across the organization, including infrastructure, tools, and business solutions. The role oversees multiple departments with enterprise-wide accountability for IT Project Management, Digital Project Management, application development (ProDev), Low-Code and digital initiatives. The IT Projects Director contributes to the definition of the company’s IT and Digital strategy and reports to the Group IT&S Director. The role is a member of key governance bodies such as the IT&S Leadership Team, IT&S Investment Committee, and Steering Committees, with regular interactions at CxO level. Responsibilities Lead and manage a large, multi-disciplinary organization (40+ headcount), including managers, across multiple geographies Manage IT and Digital project budgets, including investment decisions and contributions to the 3-year plan Define and ensure adoption of standards, methodologies, and tools (project management and development frameworks) Oversee the framing, prioritization, and delivery of digital and IT solutions Manage the IT and Digital solutions portfolio, ensuring alignment with business objectives Drive governance and delivery of Low-Code and ProDev development activities Lead digital and data-driven initiatives (including AI-related topics) Establish and coordinate internal governance bodies and communities (Low-Code, Digital Solutions Portfolio) Partner with executive leadership to define and deliver digital solutions that create business value Maintain strong alignment with peer functions (IT Operations, Enterprise Architecture, Data Management, Cybersecurity) to ensure consistency and efficiency Support executive reporting for the IT&s Director (Executive and Operations Committees, Supervisory Board, Audit & Finance Committee) Education Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technology-related field Degree in Computer Science or equivalent is a plus Experience 10+ years of professional experience, ideally in IT management roles 10+ years of people management experience in complex environments Proven leadership experience managing cross-functional, multidisciplinary teams at scale Strong experience in complex IT transformations and enterprise-wide solutions delivery Experience in designing and monitoring strategic KPIs and performance frameworks Prior exposure to complex industries (e.g. energy) is a plus Functional Competencies Compliance Governance, Risk and Control Analytics and reporting Digital savvy Business Acumen Change Management Project Cost Management Risk Management GENERAL INFORMATION SBM Offshore N.V. is a listed holding company that is headquartered in Amsterdam. It holds direct and indirect interests in other companies that collectively with SBM Offshore N.V. form the SBM Offshore Group (“the Company”). For further information, please visit our website at www.sbmoffshore.com. The companies in which SBM Offshore N.V., directly and indirectly, owns investments are separate entities. SBM Offshore is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. SBM Offshore does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

new_matches.title: Group Leader - Cloud Platform & SRE
new_matches.description: A stable and fast‑growing Network Security company is searching a Group Leader to Lead the Cloud Platform & SRE group. Responsibilities: You will lead the teams responsible for the foundational infrastructure of our global cybersecurity services. This role is a unique hybrid: you will drive the development of internal developer tools ,while taking ultimate accountability for the resilience and performance of our high-scale production environments. We are looking for a leader who moves beyond traditional monitoring toward proactive, AI-driven operations and self-healing infrastructure. Requirements 10+ years in DevOps, SRE, or Infrastructure roles, with at least 3 years of experience in leadership roles, managing technical leaders or senior engineering teams. Hands-on experience managing massive, distributed production environments. You understand the "blast radius" of every change. A passion for replacing manual toil with code. You view "automated recovery" as a requirement, not a luxury. Deep expertise in Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), Terraform, and Kafka. Proficiency in Python, Go, or Shell for advanced automation. Deep knowledge of the Prometheus/Grafana ecosystem and a clear vision for integrating AI into the monitoring lifecycle. Strong communication skills with the ability to lead through influence. You are a mentor who grows the next generation of technical talent.

new_matches.title: Field Service Engineer - UK
new_matches.description: At UVeye, we're on a mission to redefine vehicle safety and reliability on a global scale. Founded in 2016, we pioneered the world's first fully automated suite of vehicle inspection systems. At the heart of this innovation lies our advanced AI-centric technology, representing the pinnacle of computer vision, machine learning, and generative AI within the automotive sector. With over $380M in funding and strategic partnerships with industry giants such as Toyota, Amazon, General Motors, Volvo, and Hertz, our technology is utilized in manufacturing plants, dealerships, wholesale auctions, delivery fleets, seaports, and more. TDGI builds trust between governments, industry and the research community, produces foresight on tech diplomacy, and supports countries seeking to institutionalise tech diplomacy within their own systems. At a glance Reports to: Chief Operating Officer Works closely with: The Chief of Staff, the CEO and the Secretariat Contract: Full time Location: Remote, with working hours aligned to Central European Time Travel: Occasional international travel for TDGI events Start date: As soon as possible Purpose of the role We are looking for one highly capable person to hold together the operational and editorial work of a small institute with a large international footprint. The role spans communications, research support, council and event coordination, protocol and administration. It suits someone who moves quickly, writes to an academic standard, and is comfortable being the person who makes things happen across several files at once. The role works alongside our Chief of Staff, who leads contractual, membership and admissions matters. The Programme Officer takes what the institute has committed to and delivers it. This is a generalist position by design. The successful candidate will work directly with senior leadership and will be trusted with visible, sensitive work from the start. Key responsibilities Communications and social media Manage TDGI’s presence across LinkedIn and other institutional channels, including the editorial calendar, drafting and scheduling. Draft posts, announcements and speaker or partner communications in the institute’s voice. Produce visual and written content around TDGI events, publications and Expert Council activities. Track engagement and report on what is working. Research and drafting Draft reports, policy briefs, concept notes, background papers and meeting summaries to publication standard. Conduct desk research on tech diplomacy practice, national strategies and comparative country cases. Support senior leadership with speech notes, talking points and briefing materials. Maintain accuracy, sourcing and referencing across all institute outputs. Expert Council coordination Serve as the coordination point for the members of TDGI’s Expert Councils on AI, cybersecurity, quantum and space diplomacy. Plan and service council meetings, including scheduling, agendas, papers, minutes and follow up. Track deliverables and deadlines, and keep members moving toward agreed outputs. Support the drafting and production of council publications Event coordination Coordinate TDGI symposia, roundtables and convenings from concept through to delivery. Manage speaker and participant pipelines, invitations, registration, run of show and logistics. Liaise with host institutions, venues, ministries and co-organising partners. Run TDGEP logistics and event management, including venue, scheduling, materials and the on site running of sessions. Prepare event documentation and post event reporting. Protocol and institutional relations Handle protocol correspondence and courtesies with foreign ministries, permanent missions, embassies and international organisations. Prepare invitation letters, official correspondence, seating and precedence arrangements, and briefing packs for senior guests. Maintain the institute’s contact and stakeholder records. Ensure that TDGI’s dealings with government and institutional counterparts meet expected standards of form and discretion. Administration and executive support Manage the Secretariat inbox and correspondence on behalf of the leadership. Support scheduling, travel, document management and internal coordination. Provide administrative support to senior leadership as required. Take on other tasks as the institute’s work demands. Who we are looking for Essential Master’s degree or higher in international relations, political science, public policy, law, communications or a related field. Demonstrated academic writing ability, with a portfolio of written work such as a thesis, published articles, policy papers or research reports. Full professional fluency in English, plus at least one other working language. Excellent organisational skills, with a track record of managing several workstreams at once and meeting deadlines without supervision. Fast, action oriented and comfortable with ambiguity in a small team where everyone does a bit of everything. Sound judgement and discretion when handling sensitive institutional relationships. Confident with digital tools, including Google Workspace, LinkedIn and standard design and scheduling platforms. Able to work in the Central European Time zone. Desirable Experience in a ministry of foreign affairs, embassy, international organisation, think tank or similar institutional environment. Familiarity with protocol conventions and diplomatic correspondence. Interest in or exposure to technology policy, digital governance or tech diplomacy. Portuguese, Spanish, French or Arabic, given our activity in Latin America, Europe, Africa and Asia. Experience coordinating international events or expert networks. What we offer Direct exposure to senior diplomatic, governmental and industry counterparts. A wide brief with real responsibility from the outset, in a young institute that is still taking shape. The chance to contribute to the substance of TDGI’s research and publications, not only its operations. A distributed, international team. We hire wherever the right person is, provided the working day overlaps with Central European Time. Terms Full time, remote, with working hours aligned to Central European Time. TDGI is an independent institute in its early years, and a small team. We are straightforward about what that means: the salary is modest, and what this role pays in is access, responsibility and international exposure rather than money. Please include your salary expectation in your application so that we can be equally straightforward with you. How to apply Send a CV, a short cover letter and one writing sample of your own authorship, ideally academic or policy oriented, to secretariat@tdgi.org, with the subject line “Programme Officer”. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled.

Engineering Review support our Projects with best use of product placement, including liaisons with our Engineering Services Teams Asset Lifecycle & Logistics Crane Oversight Manage the deployment, erection, and dismantling of tower cranes, crawler cranes, and mobile units. Access & Hoists Supervise the installation and safety verification and all hoisting operations. Supply Chain Audit Conduct safety, financial, and operational compliance audits on third-party plant providers and transport subcontractors. Financial & Budgetary Control Capex/Opex Management Support multi-million-pound/euro capital expenditure (CAPEX) for asset purchasing and operational expenditure (OPEX). Technical & Engineering Capability - Ability to review and interpret technical drawings, lift plans, structural calculations, and crane schematics. new_matches.description: About ZEISS ZEISSグループは、創業者のカール ツァイスが1846年にドイツ東部の都市、イエナに開設した精密機器および光学部品の工房から急成長を遂げました。日本では1911年にカールツァイス株式会社が設立され、約400人の従業員が5つの事業所で販売とサービスを提供しています。ZEISS日本は半導体、自動車、機械工学、生物医学研究、医療技術のパートナーであり、眼鏡レンズやカメラレンズ、双眼鏡の大手メーカーでもあります。 職務内容 フィールドサービスエンジニアとして、弊社の機器が常に正常に稼働することを保証し、故障時には迅速かつ適切に対応すること等で、顧客満足度の向上に貢献すること。 1：機器の設置/設定（顧客先での機器の設置や設定を行い、正常に稼働するように調整します。） 2：保守/メンテナンス（定期的な保守作業や、故障時の修理を担当します。機器の状態を監視し、必要に応じて部品交換やアップグレードを行います。） 3：保守契約の案内/提案/販売 4：技術サポート（顧客からの技術的な問い合わせに対応し、問題解決を支援します。電話等でのサポートも含まれます。） 5：報告書等の作成（作業内容や問題の原因、対応策等を報告書にまとめ、関係者に提出、または社内システムに入力します。） 主製品 ・視野計ハンフリーフィールドアナライザー (国内のマーケットシェア70％以上） ・眼科手術顕微鏡(国内のマーケットシェア50％以上） ・その他外来検査器械、手術用器械を取り扱う 必須条件 ・分野を問わず、工学技術に携わる職務経験あるいは最終学歴を有すること。 ・電気/機械工学に関する基礎知識および工具を用いた機械・部品の取り扱い。日本語の読み書き/会話。 ・普通自動車免許 歓迎条件 ・フィールドサービス、光学機器メンテナンス、コンピューター機器メンテナンス等の業務経験（特に医療機器分野において） ・一般光学知識、一般コンピューター知識、コンピューターネットワーク知識、初級英語。 休日・休暇 有給休暇 初年度 2ー14日、その後勤続年数に応じて21－25日 休日 約125日 土日祝日、年末年始（12月29日-1月4日）。そのほか慶弔特別休暇。 勤務時間 9:00-17:30 （休憩1時間を含む。所定労働時間7.5時間） 時間外労働有無：業務上の必要に応じ有 福利厚生 慶弔見舞金、退職金制度、確定拠出型年金、カフェテリアポイント制度 交通費支給（上限5万円） 雇用保険、労災保険、健康保険、総合福祉団体定期保険 福利厚生俱楽部、家庭用常備薬割引、インフルエンザ予防接種補助、眼鏡購入割引 社内クラブ活動 受動喫煙防止措置：敷地内禁煙 契約期間 無期 試用期間 3カ月（最大6カ月まで延長可能性あり、条件変更なし） 就業場所 東京オフィス 変更の範囲：全国の拠点 出張 有：必要に応じて国内外出張可能性あり 給与 年収：450万円~750万円（賞与・各種手当含む、スキルご経験による） 月給：33万円~52万円 賞与：あり 昇給：あり Your ZEISS Recruiting Team Ami Takeno （竹野 碧海）, Hiroko Okuda （奥田 裕子 - オクダ ヒロコ）, Hisayo Kemmotsu （剱物 ひ沙代）, Maho Hatabayashi （畑林 真帆 - ハタバヤシ マホ）

Konzernprojekte begleiten Sie steuer­rechtlich und agieren als Ansprechpartner für steuerliche Fragestellungen im Unternehmen. Je nach Qualifikation und Interesse wirken Sie bei vielen spannenden Themen wie Verrechnungspreis­dokumentationen (Master-File, Local-File, C-b-C Reporting), Abbildung (länder­übergreifender) steuerlicher Sach­verhalte in ERP-Systemen oder gesellschafts­rechtlichen Umstrukturierungen im Konzern mit. B. zum Diplom Finanzwirt) bzw. eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung, z. Ein dynamisches und hoch motiviertes Arbeits­umfeld und Team mit flachen Hierarchien. Die Sicherheit und gleichzeitig interne Entwicklungs­möglichkeiten einer erfolg­reichen und kontinuierlich expandierenden Unternehmens­gruppe mit einer weit über 100-jährigen Firmen­geschichte und über 200 Stand­orten weltweit. Ein monatlich wechselndes Angebot an Mitarbeiter­vergünstigungen bei namhaften Herstellern. Gute Verkehrsanbindung an Hamburg und Lübeck via Pkw als auch ÖPNV (ca. 25 Fahrminuten bis HH-Hbf). Neben einer bezuschussten Betriebs­kantine an unserem Haupt­sitz in Bad Oldesloe bieten wir Ihnen kostenfreie Mitarbeiter­parkplätze.
